# Provider input script: actual retained STEP -> Gmsh mesh. No load/strength claim.
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import meshio
import numpy as np
source=Path('/inputs/design.step')
source_digest=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
proc=subprocess.run(['gmsh',str(source),'-3','-format','msh2','-o','cad-mesh.msh','-clmax','5','-clmin','1','-order','1','-v','3'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90)
Path('gmsh.stdout').write_text(proc.stdout);Path('gmsh.stderr').write_text(proc.stderr)
if proc.returncode: raise RuntimeError(f'Gmsh exited {proc.returncode}; inspect retained stderr')
mesh=meshio.read('cad-mesh.msh')
tetra=mesh.get_cells_type('tetra')
if not len(tetra): raise ValueError('No volume elements produced')
points=mesh.points
if not np.isfinite(points).all(): raise ValueError('Nonfinite mesh coordinates')
a,b,c,d=[points[tetra[:,i]] for i in range(4)]
volumes=np.abs(np.einsum('ij,ij->i',b-a,np.cross(c-a,d-a)))/6
if np.any(volumes<=1e-12): raise ValueError('Degenerate tetrahedron')
meshio.write('cad-volume-mesh.vtu',meshio.Mesh(points,[('tetra',tetra)]))
report={'scope':'CAD-derived volume meshing prerequisite; not strength or dimensional acceptance','source_sha256':source_digest,'nodes':len(points),'tetrahedra':len(tetra),'minimum_tetra_volume':float(volumes.min()),'mesh_volume_coordinate_units_cubed':float(volumes.sum()),'bounds_coordinate_units':[points.min(axis=0).tolist(),points.max(axis=0).tolist()],'gmsh_exit':proc.returncode,'files':{p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [Path('cad-mesh.msh'),Path('cad-volume-mesh.vtu')]}}
Path('mesh-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report))
